question: Which of the following states of India does not share any boundary with Nepal?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tripura.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Five Indian states **Uttarpradesh, Uttarakhand, West Bengal, Sikkim and Bihar share their borders with Nepal.**
 
• Tripura does not share any border with Nepal.
 
• Tripura is surrounded by Bangladesh on its north, south and west.
 
• The length of its international border is** 856 km.**
 
• The state is connected with the rest of India by **NH-44 **which runs through Assam, Meghalaya, North Bengal, Kolkata and other parts of India.
